acceptance_criteria.statement: One exported deeply frozen run-log grammar drives runtime validation and an exact complete run-log schema-subtree equality test.
runId matches only the generated ID grammar and rejects traversal, separators, control characters, whitespace, extensions, and case variants.
event is a bounded lowercase ASCII identifier, now is a valid Date, and data is a detached schema-compatible plain JSON object.
Validation and serialization finish before any filesystem mutation; rejected input creates no directory/file and appends no partial line.
Valid and repeated appends write newline-terminated JSON objects to the exact runs/YYYY-MM-DD/runId.jsonl path and preserve parseable JSONL.
Tests cover fixed createRunId, schema agreement, path/control/date/event/data rejects, no-side-effect failures, successful writes, repeated writes, and cleanup.
Exactly the three allowed files change; npm test and git diff --check pass without dependency, network, transfer, commit, or external changes.
